It was likewise in Recanati, and not by his own wits, that Pico found the shrewd combination of texts that brought out some particular points, such as the proper attitude at prayer (Conclusio xxxiv). And, above all, it was because he read it with the eyes of Recanati that Pico understood the Zohar so well.
